title: Clickable help and web links in browser play
content:
Browser play

  • Click a help reference or help search result to open that topic. You can follow another help link while reading a paged help entry, just as you can type a new help command.
  • Web addresses beginning with http:// or https:// open in a separate browser tab, including links in chat and saved chat history. Links keep their complete destination when their text wraps.
  • Help links work with the keyboard, too. Game output never opens a link or sends a help command until you activate it.
  • Ship contacts and status clear when you disconnect, return to the character menu, or change characters. Radar keeps showing a contact's range and bearing when its world-map position is unavailable.
  • Literal ampersands and URL parameters remain readable in game output.
